Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

factomics 0.1.0

First public release.

New methods

  • run_factor_pipeline() now also runs block-weighted PCA, SGCCA (mixOmics) and JIVE (r.jive), alongside FABIA, MOFA2, GFA and MFA.
  • list_factor_methods() lists the methods and whether each is installed.
  • A failing method is skipped with a warning (stop_on_error = FALSE) instead of stopping the whole pipeline.
  • New mofa_python and mofa_use_basilisk arguments for MOFA2’s Python backend.

New downstream tools

  • Embeddings: compute_embedding(), embed_results() and plot_embedding() (PCA, UMAP, t-SNE).
  • Clustering: cluster_samples(), cluster_results(), compare_clusterings(), adjusted_rand_index() and plot_clusters() (k-means, hierarchical, PAM, with k chosen by silhouette).
  • Interpretation: variance_explained(), plot_variance_explained(), factor_associations(), plot_factor_associations(), plot_top_loadings(), plot_factor_heatmap(), plot_factor_scores().
  • factomics() runs the whole workflow in one call; export_results() writes CSV tables.
  • simulate_multiomics() generates multi-omics data with known factors.
  • Docker image with every method pre-installed (including mofapy2) and a command-line tool, factomics-cli.

Fixes

  • The package can be installed again: analysis code that had been left at the top level of R/pipeline.R ran (and failed) at build time.
  • The package now sits at the repository root, so remotes::install_github("lucp12891/factomics") works.
  • attach_scores_metadata(), merge_scores_with_metadata() and benchmark_factor_methods() use every method in the results by default, not only the original four, and keep the original sample order.
  • Factor matching in the grid plots matches samples by ID, not by row position.
  • plot_scores_scatter_grid() and plot_scores_lollipop_grid() accept any number of methods; align_to = "auto" picks MOFA when present.
  • MOFA2 scores are returned in the input sample order, and its HDF5 file is written to tempdir() by default instead of the working directory.

Earlier development

  • FABIA, MOFA2, GFA and MFA behind run_factor_pipeline(), with benchmarking and score plots.
